mapper.select: SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_id AS "couponId", uc.status, uc.order_id AS "orderId", uc.used_at AS "usedAt", uc.created_at AS "createdAt", c.name, c.type, c.threshold AS "minAmount", c.discount, c.end_time AS "endTime" FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 1, order_id = #{orderId}, used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 0, order_id = NULL, used_at = NULL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1
